newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes lower on hedge selling.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes lower on hedge selling.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower with hedge selling weighing on nearby March, traders said.
Country Hedging was a key seller of 1.5 million bushels in the March contract, the traders said.
MGE wheat also was hit by a sharp drop in CBOT soybean futures.

Traders said mill buying underpinned the market with LFG Futures a key player in the intermarket spread with Chicago. "They bought Minneapolis and sold Chicago," a trader said referring to the LFG spread action.
MGE barley futures trading was quiet with the March offered at $6.62 per cwt and no trades were made. The May was bid at $6.65 per cwt also amid no trading.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 1/2 to 3-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with March down 3-1/2 at $3.83-1/4.
